# Icarus tactical assets

AimCodes uses tactical map SVG files in `public/images/playbook/maps/` and agent
portrait / ability WebP files in `public/images/playbook/agents/` from the
open-source Icarus project.

- Source: https://github.com/SunkenInTime/icarus
- Source commit: `d7354a442f7be31467f935bf6c6adb303081d597`
- Imported files: the 13 base map SVGs from `assets/maps/`; 29 agent portraits
  and four primary ability icons per agent from `assets/agents/`
- Local changes: map filenames were normalized to lowercase. The imported SVG
  and WebP contents were not modified.
- License: Apache License 2.0. See `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` in this directory.

The map names and underlying game-related artwork remain subject to their
respective owners' rights. This project is an independent fan-made tool and is
not endorsed by Riot Games.
